doc.affix_prop_children: Children to be rendered inside the affix
doc.affix_prop_offsetBottom: Offset distance from the bottom of the window (in pixels)
doc.affix_prop_offsetTop: Offset distance from the top of the window (in pixels)
doc.affix_prop_onChange: Callback when the affix state changes
doc.affix_prop_target: Target container that will be scrolled
doc.anchor_prop_bounds: Bounding distance (in pixels) for triggering active state
doc.anchor_prop_offset: Offset (in pixels) from top when clicking to scroll
doc.backTop_prop_children: Children to be rendered inside the button
doc.backTop_prop_target: Target container that will be scrolled
doc.backTop_prop_visibilityHeight: Scroll height after which the button becomes visible
doc.breadcrumb_prop_ariaLabel: Accessible label of the navigation landmark. Defaults to a localized "breadcrumb" label.
doc.breadcrumb_prop_asChild: If true, the breadcrumb will be rendered as its child, merging its props onto that child.
doc.breadcrumb_prop_className: Additional CSS class name for the container.
doc.breadcrumb_prop_items: Items to display, from the root to the current page.
doc.breadcrumb_prop_separator: Separator displayed between items. Defaults to a chevron icon.
doc.commandPalette_prop_onOpenChange: Called with the next state when the palette is opened or closed.
doc.commandPalette_prop_open: Controlled open state. Use together with onOpenChange.
doc.hamburgerMenu_prop_onClick: Callback function when the menu is toggled
doc.hamburgerMenu_prop_visibleBelow: Show only below the given breakpoint (e.g. "md" matches Sidebar's mobile drawer range)
doc.link_prop_asChild:
If true, the link will be rendered as its child, merging its props onto that child.
Useful for using the link styles with Link components from React Router or Next.js.
doc.link_prop_external:
If true, opens the link in a new tab and shows an external-link icon.
@default false
doc.link_prop_iconName: Name of the icon displayed alongside the label.
doc.link_prop_iconPosition:
Position of the icon relative to the label.
@default "left"
doc.link_prop_label: Link text or element. Alternative to children.
doc.pagination_prop_hideOnSinglePage: Whether to hide the pagination if there is only one page
doc.pagination_prop_onPageSizeChange: Callback function when page size changes
doc.pagination_prop_pageSizeOptions: Page size options for the page size changer
doc.pagination_prop_showSizeChanger: Whether to show the page size changer
doc.pagination_prop_showTotal: Function to display the total count
doc.pagination_prop_siblingCount: Number of sibling pages to show around the current page
doc.pagination_prop_simple: Whether to show a simplified version
doc.speedDial_prop_actions: Actions to display when SpeedDial is open
doc.speedDial_prop_activeIcon: Icon name for the main button when open
doc.speedDial_prop_icon: Icon name for the main button when closed
doc.speedDial_prop_trigger: Trigger mode to open the SpeedDial
doc.stepper_prop_asChild: Whether to use the Radix Slot pattern
doc.stepper_prop_current: Index of the current active step (0-indexed)
doc.stepper_prop_intent: Workflow intent shown on the current active step (default: "process")
doc.stepper_prop_onChange: Callback function when a step is clicked (if applicable)
doc.tabBar_prop_fixed: Fixed position at the bottom of the screen
doc.tabs_prop_defaultValue: Value of the tab selected initially, for uncontrolled usage.
doc.tabs_prop_onChange: Called with the value of the newly selected tab.
doc.tabs_prop_orientation:
Orientation of the tab list, affecting layout and arrow-key navigation.
@default "horizontal"
doc.tabs_prop_value: Controlled value of the selected tab. Use together with onChange.
